doc: Compound recipe for Timeline 0.1’s fx {grayscale, brightness}: **line-for-line equivalent to studio_export’s apply_media_effects**. In the same loop, it first interpolates toward Rec.709 luminance, then adds the brightness offset, and finally does one clamp+premultiply. Chaining two filters would add an extra u8 round-trip and produce different pixels, so it is its own recipe.
